summary: Figure 5b reports 23 semaglutide-versus-vehicle discoveries without identifying the genes. The registered edgeR table has zero discoveries at the same FDR < 0.05 cutoff. The published gene-level panels use a different contrast or cohort, so gene-level agreement remains unassessed. [Published Figure 5](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07419-8/figures/5)
openIssues: The authors’ Figure 5 peptide-versus-vehicle DESeq2 table and original 0149 sample-to-treatment key are needed to identify the 23 genes and investigate the discovery-count difference.
